mapper.select: SELECT document_id, original_file_name, storage_file_name, source_format, file_size, title, summary, keywords, document_type, status, error_message, uploaded_by, processing_attempts, created_at, updated_at FROM ai_knowledge_document ORDER BY updated_at DESC, document_id DESC

SELECT document_id, original_file_name, title, summary, keywords, document_type, updated_at FROM ai_knowledge_document WHERE status = 'READY' AND ( original_file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR COALESCE(title, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR COALESCE(summary, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') OR COALESCE(keywords, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') ) ORDER BY CASE WHEN original_file_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 0 WHEN COALESCE(title, '') LIKE CONCAT('%', #{query}, '%') THEN 1 ELSE 2 END, updated_at DESC LIMIT #{limit}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO ai_knowledge_document (original_file_name, storage_file_name, source_format, file_size, status, uploaded_by, processing_attempts, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{originalFileName}, #{storageFileName}, #{sourceFormat}, #{fileSize}, #{status}, #{uploadedBy}, #{processingAttempts}, NOW(), NOW())
mapper.update: UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET storage_file_name = #{storageFileName}, source_format = #{sourceFormat}, file_size = #{fileSize}, title = NULL, summary = NULL, keywords = NULL, document_type = NULL, markdown_content = NULL, status = 'PROCESSING', error_message = NULL, uploaded_by = #{uploadedBy}, processing_attempts = 0, updated_at = NOW() WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET status = 'PROCESSING', error_message = NULL, processing_attempts = processing_attempts + 1, updated_at = NOW() WHERE document_id = #{documentId}

UPDATE ai_knowledge_document SET title = #{title}, summary = #{summary}, keywords = #{keywords}, document_type = #{documentType}, markdown_content = #{markdownContent}, status = 'READY', error_message = NULL, updated_at = NOW() WHERE document_id = #{documentId}
